A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MGMT gene rs12917 TT and rs11016819 AG genotypes increase the risk of developing HNSCC, whereas the rs11016819 AA genotype increases the risk for nodal metastasis.
the MGMT polymorphsisms rs12917 (TT genotype) and rs1101689 (AG genotype) increase the risk of HNNSCC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the MGMT gene is a potential biomarker of HNSCC.
the examined polymorphic variants of MGMT may be considered as risk factors for HNSC.
